title: Orders
intro: The Orders screen lists open and recent checks so you can pay, print, split, merge, cancel, or refund without returning to the floor plan.

sections.title: Orders layout
sections.intro: Open Orders from the left sidebar. Filters sit at the top; order cards (or table rows) fill the main area.
steps: Tap Orders in the sidebar.
Use filters to narrow by status, order type, floor, user, and date.
Switch between Blocks and Table views with the toolbar buttons.
sections.caption: Orders screen with filters and cards.

sections.title: Filters
steps: Status: In Progress, Paid, Cancelled, Split, Merged (multi-select).
Order type, floor, and user filters limit who and where.
The date picker shows paid/historical checks for that day; In Progress still appears when relevant.
sections.caption: Orders filter bar.

sections.title: Toolbar
steps: Open cash drawer pulses the cash drawer when printing and permissions allow it (may require manager PIN).
Blocks shows large order cards.
Table shows a compact list (tap an In Progress row to pay).
sections.caption: Cash drawer and view toggles.

sections.title: Order card
sections.intro: Each card shows header, times, line items, totals, and action buttons for In Progress checks.
steps: Review invoice number, table, status, server, and items.
Temp bill (print) and Pay (card icon) appear for In Progress orders.
Use the ⋯ menu for cancel, split, merge, and kitchen print.
sections.caption: Order card with items and actions.

sections.title: Card actions
steps: Temp bill prints a provisional check when allowed.
Pay opens the full payment screen for that order.
⋯ opens more actions (see next section).
sections.caption: Print, Pay, and more on a card.

sections.title: More menu (In Progress)
sections.intro: Protected actions may ask for a manager PIN.
steps: Cancel order voids the check through the cancel flow.
Split by seats, items, or amount divides one check into multiple.
Merge selects this order for multi-table merge (finish with Choose table on the bottom bar).
Print KOT copy re-fires kitchen tickets when needed.
sections.caption: Order more-actions menu.

sections.title: Table view
steps: Switch to Table for a dense list of today’s matching orders.
Tap an In Progress row to open payment quickly.
sections.caption: Orders table view.
